kin.text: Ah, a colleague! Do mind the stairs; they're shy. The Fourfold Threshold chose you for us. Now the Hollowing is chewing at the edges of the dream, and The Spiral Concordance needs hands that can do what yours can.

options.text: Tell me about The Spiral Concordance.

offer.text: Use what you are. There are seals in this meadow only our calling can open, and things out there that need answering. Do it, then come back.

progress.text: Check your journal, then go. The seals won't open themselves.

rewarded.text: Well done. You are one of us in more than name now. Take this — and the vault of The Spiral Concordance is yours to open.

lore.text: The Concordance believes the dream has rules, and that rules can be rewritten. They keep the Key of Laws behind seven locks.

stranger.text: Visitor. You haven't signed the ledger. Nobody ever signs the ledger. You are not of our calling. But the dream is wide, and goodwill is a kind of door.

options.text: How do I earn your trust?
Here — I brought what you asked.

goodwill.text: Bring us 3 gremlin cogs. Small things build bridges. Large things build bigger ones.

options.text: I'll see what I can find.

goodwill_done.text: ...You actually did it. The Spiral Concordance will remember.
